description: The application seeks planning permission/listed building consent for works to the existing mansard roof level, including enlargement of the dormer window, roof refurbishment, and minor internal adjustments. The dormer window is to be enlarged to achieve improved proportions and a more coherent relationship with the roof form. The revised design introduces a balanced, vertically aligned composition, informed by proportional analysis (see Drg. A-205), and remains subservient to the overall roof structure. The approach responds to the shortcomings of the existing dormer and reflects nearby precedent, including No. 79 (Ref: 2022/2108). The existing felt roof covering, associated with the late 20th century mansard addition, will be replaced with a Sarnafil single-ply membrane to match the existing appearance while improving durability. The roof build-up will be upgraded to improve thermal performance. No changes are proposed to the roof form, pitch, or profile. Minor internal adjustments are proposed within the mansard level only. These works have no impact on historic fabric or lower floor plan form and result in no external change.
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The Development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.

<p>Unless otherwise hereby approved, all new works in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works to be carried out in this connection) shall match the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance.

</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To safeguard the significance of the listed building.</p>
